title: Purported AI-Generated Video Reportedly Used in RM5,800 (~$1,400) Sextortion Attempt Targeting Malaysian Minor via Telegram

behaviors.text: A Malaysian family reported that scammers used purported AI-generated explicit video content to target their teenage son in a sextortion attempt.
The perpetrators allegedly contacted the boy via Telegram, sending manipulated footage that depicted him in compromising situations and demanding RM5,800 (~$1,400) to prevent its release.
